notes: Original abstract grove 'Lumen Grove': procedurally generated luminous tree (seeded recursion), instanced branches/leaves, drifting motes, animated emissive core, gentle ambient motion; meaningful interaction = custom orbit/pan/zoom camera (mouse, keyboard, touch) plus clicking/tapping a leaf or core to send a pulse of light propagating across instanced leaves; Pulse/Reset/Pause/Pulse-speed controls; keyboard shortcuts; ARIA labels, instructions, aria-live status; responsive + ResizeObserver + devicePixelRatio cap 2; prefers-reduced-motion respected; WebGL/WebGLRenderer failure detection with deliberate fallback + retry; no build step, no extra libraries, no local assets. Three.js exactly pinned 0.160.0 from jsDelivr CDN; requires network access to the CDN and a WebGL-capable browser. MODEL_SLUG resolved as 'unknown-model': the active model identity is withheld per confidentiality policy and not disclosed in this submission; no identity is invented. Known limitations: pulse propagation is CPU-side per-instance color animation (fine for ~300 leaves); no persistence; single static scene.
